name: nutrient-dws-mcp-server
description: Process, sign, redact, and transform documents from Claude Desktop using Nutrient.
long_description: A local Claude Desktop extension for document processing with Nutrient. It runs as a stdio MCP server, reads files from a user-selected sandbox directory, opens a browser for OAuth on the first request that uses the Nutrient API, and writes processed results back to local output paths.

tools.name: document_processor
tools.description: Convert, OCR, extract, watermark, rotate, flatten annotations, and process documents.

tools.name: document_signer
tools.description: Digitally sign PDF files with CMS or CAdES signatures.

tools.name: ai_redactor
tools.description: Detect and permanently redact sensitive content such as names, addresses, SSNs, and emails.

tools.name: parse_document
tools.description: Parse a document into spatial elements with bounding boxes, or into Markdown.

tools.name: extract_fields
tools.description: Pull specific named fields from a document into a JSON shape you define, with per-field citations.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check the current Nutrient DWS credit balance and usage.

tools.name: sandbox_file_tree
tools.description: Browse files available in the configured sandbox directory.

sandbox_path.title: Sandbox Directory
sandbox_path.description: Directory the extension can read from and write to for document processing.

prompts.name: sign_and_watermark
prompts.description: Add a text watermark to a document, then digitally sign the watermarked PDF.
prompts.text:
Watermark ${arguments.input_path} with "${arguments.watermark_text}", then digitally sign it and save the final PDF to ${arguments.output_path}.
Use an intermediate path formed by appending ".watermarked.pdf" to ${arguments.output_path}.
1. Call document_processor with instructions = {"parts":[{"file":"${arguments.input_path}"}],"actions":[{"type":"watermark","watermarkType":"text","text":"${arguments.watermark_text}","width":"80%","height":"20%","opacity":0.3}],"output":{"type":"pdf"}} and outputPath = the intermediate path.
2. Call document_signer with filePath = the intermediate path and outputPath = ${arguments.output_path}.
Paths resolve inside the sandbox directory when one is configured.

prompts.name: extract_document_fields
prompts.description: Extract named fields from a document into a JSON object, optionally retaining citations in a file.
prompts.text:
Extract these comma-separated fields from ${arguments.input_path}: ${arguments.fields}.
Call extract_fields exactly once with filePath = ${arguments.input_path}, schema = a JSON object schema whose properties are the trimmed field names from "${arguments.fields}" and whose property values are {"type":"string"}, and mode = "understand".
Use mode = "structure" instead only when the document is a clean scan and the cheaper option is preferred.
If ${arguments.output_path} is non-empty, also pass outputPath = ${arguments.output_path}; otherwise omit outputPath.
Paths resolve inside the sandbox directory when one is configured.

prompts.name: redact_pii
prompts.description: Detect and permanently redact personally identifiable information from a document.
prompts.text:
Permanently redact personally identifiable information from ${arguments.input_path} and save it to ${arguments.output_path}.
Call ai_redactor with filePath = ${arguments.input_path} and outputPath = ${arguments.output_path}.
When entity_types is non-empty, pass criteria = "${arguments.entity_types}"; otherwise omit criteria to use the tool default entity set.
Paths resolve inside the sandbox directory when one is configured.

prompts.name: parse_for_rag
prompts.description: Parse a document as Markdown for retrieval-augmented generation and search indexing.
prompts.text:
Parse ${arguments.input_path} into Markdown for RAG and write it to ${arguments.output_path}.
Call parse_document with filePath = ${arguments.input_path}, format = "markdown", mode = "text", and outputPath = ${arguments.output_path}.
mode = "text" is the cheapest mode and does no OCR; use mode = "structure" for scans that need OCR, or omit mode to use the default "understand" for mixed or low-quality content.
Paths resolve inside the sandbox directory when one is configured.

prompts.name: office_to_pdfa
prompts.description: Convert an Office document to an archival PDF/A file.
prompts.text:
Convert the Office document ${arguments.input_path} to PDF/A and save it to ${arguments.output_path}.
Call document_processor with instructions = {"parts":[{"file":"${arguments.input_path}"}],"output":{"type":"pdfa"}} and outputPath = ${arguments.output_path}.
Paths resolve inside the sandbox directory when one is configured.
